resource.title: [Jules Task 10] Adversarial OCR & Noisy Quote Parsing Suite
resource.prompt:
Create an adversarial OCR and chaotic quote parsing unit test suite in tests/test_ocr_adversarial_parser.js:
1. Test scripts/lib/boq_parser.js and scripts/lib/ocr_service.js with noisy tabular inputs: multi-currency symbols ($/€/£), mixed whitespace, messy description lines, and missing quantity columns.
2. Test SKU regex extraction against edge cases: truncated SKUs, lowercase prefixes, and embedded serial numbers.
3. Test FIFO key rotation failover under rapid simulated 429 quota exhaustion.
Ensure all tests pass and integrate into npm run test:all.
